messages:
Marta (Recruiter): Quick ask 1 new engineering manager starting next Tue. Hiring manager wants a 1-page "manager onboarding cheat-sheet" (day-by-day first week + short 30/60/90 bullets + quick 'who to ping' list). Can People Ops + DevEx kick this over?

Priya: Yep, I'll draft a tiny, copy-paste friendly checklist. Keep it <1 page so recruiters can attach to offer timeline.

Jordan (IT): FYI laptop provisioning for manager class machines is usually 3 business days. If we need faster we can ship from spare pool but need sign-off. Also need full legal name + personal email to pre-create SSO account.

Sam (DevEx): I can add 3 CLI snippets to get GitHub + CI tokens and a quick 'run-local' command. Happy to be the infra contact week 1.

Priya: Draft below (single-column checkboxes). Edit inline.

```
Pre-start (before Day 1)
- HR forms & benefits link (People Ops)
- Order laptop + peripherals; confirm shipping address (IT)
- Add to Slack, Google Workspace, company calendar (People Ops)
- Create GitHub invite and JIRA account (Manager / IT)

Day 1 AM
- 30m welcome with hiring manager: expectations, top 3 priorities (Manager)
- Team intro round (15m) (Manager)
- Laptop SSO, MFA, email setup (IT)

Day 1 PM
- Access checklist: GitHub org, CI, JIRA, Datadog, Redwood Console (Sam/Jordan/Manager)
- Schedule weekly 1:1s + send first 1:1 agenda template (Manager)

Days 2-5 (first week focus)
- Product & architecture walk-throughs (Eng lead)
- Meet 1:1 with direct reports + skip-level intro (Manager)
- Complete security & compliance short courses (Security)
- Sign up for on-call rotation & read escalation doc (Eng-SRE)
- Run local dev environment setup guide (DevEx)

By Day 10
- Manager and new hire co-draft 30/60/90 goals; share to manager inbox (Manager/New Hire)
- Assign mentor / buddy for first 90 days (Manager)

30/60/90 (copy-paste paragraphs)
- 30 days: Learn the product, team dynamics, current priorities. Run first 1:1s and close onboarding gaps.
- 60 days: Own a delivery milestone, propose at least one operational improvement, and demonstrate team ramp.
- 90 days: Drive planning for the next quarter, surface hiring/resource needs, and own roadmap commitments.

Who to ping (fast list)
- IT (Jordan) 1 laptop, SSO issues
- DevEx (Sam) 1 repo access, local dev setup, CI tokens
- Security 1 training & compliance questions
- Eng-SRE 1 on-call & paging runbook

Quick copy for offer/email: "On Day 1 we'll do a 30-minute welcome with your manager, team intros, and get you access to code, CI, and monitoring. We'll share a draft 30/60/90 in the first 10 days so expectations are aligned."
```

Alex M: Love it. Add a checkbox for 'verify dashboards & error budget' and include link to on-call rota.

Priya: Added the checkbox and will embed links in Confluence template. Will post final version EOD Fri.

Nina (People Ops): Thanks all. Marta: attach once finalised.

Marta (Recruiter): Will do. Thanks!
